STATIC_ROUTE_TEST.desc: Configure basic static route with default VRFs with PREFIX

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_INTERFACE.desc: Configure with nexthop as interface instead of IP address

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_ADVERTISE.desc: Configure static route with advertise flag

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_VRF.desc: Configure with routes in non default VRF

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_KEY_VRF_MGMT.desc: Configure with routes in mgmt VRF as key

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_VRF_MGMT.desc: Configure with routes with mgmt VRF as next hop

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_VRF_LEAK.desc: Configure with route leak across VRFS

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP.desc: Configure comma separated values for ECMP, with nexthop as PREFIX

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP_WITH_INTERFACE.desc: Configure comma separated values with nexthop as INTERFACE

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP_WITH_MGMT.desc: Configure comma separated values with one nexthop as mgmt

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BLACKHOLE_INVALID.desc: Configure with invalid value for blackhole

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_ADVERTISE_INVALID.desc: Configure static route with invalid advertise flag value

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_NEXTHOP_VRF_INVALID.desc: Configure with invalid value for VRF

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP_DISTANCE_INVALID.desc: Configure with invalid distance for ECMP

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP_BLACKHOLE_INVALID.desc: Configure with invalid blackhop for ECMP

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP_NEXTHOP_VRF_INVAL.desc: Configure with invalid vrf for ECMP

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_NEXTHOP_EMPTY_VRF.desc: Configure with null value for VRF

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_SOURCE_WITHOUT_BFD.desc: bfd-source on a nexthop whose bfd is explicitly false is rejected
eStr: bfd-source applies only when bfd is enabled

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_SOURCE_AF_MISMATCH.desc: An IPv6 bfd-source on an IPv4 gateway is rejected: FRR keys the session on one address family

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_SOURCE_SINGLE_HOP.desc: A single-hop session may name its local address

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_MULTIHOP_WITHOUT_S.desc: bfd-multihop without bfd-source is rejected: a multihop session needs an explicit local address

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_MULTIHOP_WITHOUT_B.desc: bfd-multihop on a nexthop whose bfd is not enabled is rejected
eStr: applies only when bfd is enabled

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_MULTIHOP_WITH_SOUR.desc: A multihop session with its local address and a profile, for a recursive gateway

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_ON_INTERFACE_ONLY.desc: bfd on an interface-only nexthop (gateway 'none') is rejected: there is no address to monitor

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_ON_BLACKHOLE.desc: bfd on a blackhole nexthop is rejected even when a gateway is written on the row

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_IPV6_WITH_SOURCE.desc: IPv6 nexthop with BFD, an IPv6 local address and a profile

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_IPV6_SOURCE_AF_MIS.desc: An IPv4 bfd-source on an IPv6 gateway is rejected

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_TEMPLATE_LIST_WITH.desc: BFD with a profile on the template (vrf-less) nexthop list, which shares the same attribute grouping

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BFD_TEMPLATE_LIST_ON_I.desc: bfd on an interface-only nexthop is rejected on the template list too

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_PORTCHANNEL.desc: Configure a nexthop whose egress interface is an existing port channel

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_PORT_MISSING.desc: Reject a nexthop whose egress interface names a port missing from PORT

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_INTERNAL_PORT.desc: Reject a nexthop whose egress interface is an internal port, even one in PORT
eStr: An internal port is not a nexthop egress interface

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_VLAN.desc: Configure a nexthop whose egress interface is an existing VLAN

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_VLAN_MISSING.desc: Reject a nexthop whose egress interface names a VLAN missing from VLAN

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_SUBINTERFACE_MI.desc: Reject a nexthop whose egress interface names a sub-interface missing from VLAN_SUB_INTERFACE, even on an existing port

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_LOOPBACK.desc: Configure a nexthop whose egress interface is an existing loopback

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_LOOPBACK_MISSIN.desc: Reject a nexthop whose egress interface names a loopback missing from LOOPBACK_INTERFACE

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_MGMT_PORT_WITHO.desc: Configure a nexthop out eth0 with no MGMT_PORT row, as when ZTP brings eth0 up on DHCP
